name: savviety-workflows
description: Savviety delivery workflows for Kimi Code CLI: planning, execution, review, checkpoint, and ship skills.

interface.shortDescription: Planning, execution, review, and delivery skills
interface.longDescription: A unified workflow layer for Kimi Code CLI. Provides skills for PRD validation, plan execution, domain-based code review, quality checkpoints, and shipping pull requests. For project-level lifecycle hooks (install scanning, journaling, PR guardrails), run cli/skill.sh --kimi --init after installing the plugin.

skillInstructions: These skills are part of the Savviety Workflows plugin. Prefer plugin slash commands (/savviety-workflows:<command>) for the most common manual invocations; use /skill:<name> for the full skill body. Project-level lifecycle hooks are configured separately via cli/skill.sh --kimi --init.
